Build the spatial neighbourhood graph for areal models

Source: R/structure.R
svy_adjacency.Rd

Creates a contiguity graph with spdep::poly2nb(), connects islands (areas with no neighbours) to their nearest area, and returns a sparse adjacency matrix ready for INLA together with a fixed area index.

Usage

svy_adjacency(
  boundaries,
  area_col = "area_id",
  queen = TRUE,
  connect_islands = TRUE,
  snap = NULL
)

Arguments

boundaries

An sf polygon object.

area_col

Area identifier column. Must be unique.

queen

Use queen contiguity (shared vertex) rather than rook (shared edge).

connect_islands

Link each island to its nearest area.

snap

Distance tolerance passed to spdep::poly2nb(), in the units of the boundary CRS. Small values fix slivers between neighbouring polygons that do not quite touch.

Value

An object of class svy_graph: a list with

  • adj: sparse binary adjacency matrix (Matrix::dgCMatrix)

  • nb: the spdep neighbour list

  • index: data frame mapping area_col to integer area_idx

  • n_components: number of connected components

  • islands_linked: area ids that were connected to a neighbour

Details

The area index matters: INLA identifies areas by integer position in the graph, so data must be indexed with the same ordering. svy_fit_bym2() handles this using the index table returned here.

Disconnected groups of several areas (for example an archipelago region) are left as separate components. BYM2 with scale.model = TRUE scales each component separately, which is the recommended treatment (Freni-Sterrantino et al., 2018, Spatial and Spatio-temporal Epidemiology 26:25-34).
